work.work-title: CARRY ME BACK TO OLD VIRGINIA

credit.credit-words: CARRY ME BACK TO OLD VIRGINIA
THE PUBLIC DOMAIN SONG ANTHOLOGY | https://doi.org/10.32881/book2

direction-type.words: Forgotten after Bland’s death, “Carry me Back” and Bland’s other famous tunes gathered renewed interest after his grave was discovered and an article about him was published in Etude magazine in 1939. “Carry me back” was the state song of Virginia from 1940 until 1997, being retired because of the racial insensitivity of some of the lyrics. Some performers, like Ray Charles, have recorded powerful re-imaginings of the song, modifying the lyrics to reflect on a longing for the reunion of Black families and communities torn apart by slavery.
